User.title: User
User.description: Represents a user in the system.

username.description: Username of the user. Must be unique.

adminId.description: Reference to the User who created the room. (Relationship: User 1:N Room)

maxOrangeTeamPlayers.description: Maximum number of players allowed on the Orange team.

maxPurpleTeamPlayers.description: Maximum number of players allowed on the Purple team.

maxSpectators.description: Maximum number of spectators allowed in the room.

RoomPlayer.title: RoomPlayer
RoomPlayer.description: Represents a player's presence in a room.

id.description: Unique identifier for the room player relationship.

roomId.description: Reference to the Room. (Relationship: Room 1:N RoomPlayer)

userId.description: Reference to the User. (Relationship: User 1:N RoomPlayer)

team.description: The team the player is on (e.g., 'orange', 'purple', 'spectator').

characterId.description: Reference to the Character selected by the player. Null if no character has been selected yet. (Relationship: Character 1:N RoomPlayer)

superArtId.description: Reference to the SuperArt selected by the player. Null if no SuperArt has been selected yet.

Character.title: Character
Character.description: Represents a character available for drafting.

SuperArt.title: SuperArt
SuperArt.description: Represents a Super Art that can be selected.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Super Art.

imageUrl.description: URL of the Super Art's image.

DraftSelection.title: DraftSelection
DraftSelection.description: Represents a character selection during a draft round.

id.description: Unique identifier for the draft selection.

roomId.description: Reference to the Room. (Relationship: Room 1:N DraftSelection)

characterId.description: Reference to the Character selected. (Relationship: Character 1:N DraftSelection)

userId.description: Reference to the User who made the selection. (Relationship: User 1:N DraftSelection)

selectionOrder.description: The order in which the character was selected during the draft.

timestamp.description: Timestamp of when the selection was made.

firestore.reasoning: The Firestore data structure is designed to support the character draft system, focusing on authorization independence, clarity, and scalability. User data is stored in `/users/{userId}`, ensuring straightforward access and management. Rooms are located at `/rooms/{roomId}`, each containing details about the room's configuration and status. Player participation within rooms is modeled using the `/rooms/{roomId}/roomPlayers/{roomPlayerId}` subcollection.  Denormalization is applied by copying relevant `Room` data (e.g., `adminId`, `maxOrangeTeamPlayers`, `maxPurpleTeamPlayers`, `maxSpectators`, `status`) into each `RoomPlayer` document to guarantee authorization independence. This eliminates the need for `get()` calls in security rules when accessing player-specific room data. The `team` attribute within `RoomPlayer` also denormalizes team information for easy access. Draft selections are tracked within each room using the `/rooms/{roomId}/draftSelections/{draftSelectionId}` subcollection. This structure facilitates QAPs by using path-based rules for user-owned data and leveraging denormalization to avoid complex rule evaluations. Global roles are managed through the `/roles_admin/{userId}` collection, allowing for simple existence checks to determine administrative privileges. The segregation of room-specific data into subcollections ensures each document shares the same security posture, further simplifying rule creation and maintenance.
